name: [Withered Grove 🧿] Arcane Lineage
desc:
⚠️WARNING ⚠️ This game sometimes contains bright, flashing lights and or screens, which may cause discomfort or seizures for players with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

Controls:
Q - Dash
M - Meditate at a mat
B/Tilde (`) - Open inventory and status menu
Space - Activates QTEs, can be used to block/dodge and such instead of clicking.
Left Ctrl - Location Icons

Inspired by Platform Battles, made by 123maor
